initial_state.pc: validated image entry for SDHC/UART; 0x00001000 for JTAG

initial_mappings.bytes: round_up(payload_bytes - exec_bytes + bss_bytes, 4096); omit when zero

initial_mappings.use: UART, SDHC, and PCIe register BARs

reset_grant.discovery: enumerate CAPS; the only class-21 reset-granted entry is slot 2; obtain child Devices by device.get using the profile registry below

offsets.0x04: STATUS R: bit0 RX_VALID, bit1 TX_READY, bit2 RX_OVERRUN, bit3 FRAME_ERROR
offsets.0x08: CONTROL RW: bit0 ENABLE, bit1 RX_IRQ_EN, bit2 TX_IRQ_EN; reset 0
offsets.0x10: IRQ_STATUS W1C: bit0 RX, bit1 TX, bit2 ERROR

offsets.0x04: CMD W: bit31 START, bit8 DATA_PRESENT, bits5:0 INDEX
offsets.0x1c: BLOCK RW: bits31:16 COUNT, bits15:0 BYTES; reset bytes=512
offsets.0x20: STATUS R: bit0 CMD_BUSY, bit1 DATA_BUSY, bit2 RX_READY, bit3 TX_READY, bit4 CARD_PRESENT
offsets.0x24: CONTROL RW: bit0 ENABLE, bit1 DATA_4BIT, bit2 HIGH_SPEED; reset 0
offsets.0x2c: IRQ_STATUS W1C: bit0 CMD_DONE, bit1 DATA_DONE, bit2 TIMEOUT, bit3 CRC_ERROR

offsets.0x00: STATUS R: bit0 LINK_UP, bit1 BUS_MASTER_EN, bit2 MSI_EN, bit3 DMA_BUSY, bit4 DMA_FAULT
offsets.0x04: CONTROL RW: bit0 ENDPOINT_ENABLE, bit1 DMA_ABORT
offsets.0x08: REQUESTER_ID R: bits15:0 BDF assigned by root complex
offsets.0x24: DMA_COMMAND W: bit0 START, bit1 HOST_TO_SOC; all other bits zero
offsets.0x28: DMA_STATUS R/W1C: bit0 DONE, bit1 DENIED, bit2 MALFORMED, bit3 ABORTED

HALT.update: value 1 requests a bounded halt of selected target

RESUME.update: value 1 resumes selected target and clears single-step-complete

REGADDR.layout: [15:0] register address, [16] arm one REGDATA write

REGDATA.update: write only when armed; arm clears after update

MEMADDR.layout: [63:0] virtual byte address, [64] arm one MEMDATA write

MEMDATA.capture: when unarmed, read 8 bytes through selected target translation; when armed, capture zero
MEMDATA.update: when armed, write the shifted 8 bytes; arm clears after update
MEMDATA.autoincrement: 8 bytes on Update-DR after a successful unarmed read or armed write

STATUS.layout: bit0 HALTED, bit1 HALT_PENDING, bit2 STEP_COMPLETE, bit3 ERROR, bits5:4 core, bits7:6 context; remaining zero

register_addresses.0x0042: stop cause: 0 running, 1 requested halt, 2 architectural exit, 3 unhandled precise fault
register_addresses.0x0043: architectural exit value, 64 bits; zero unless stop cause is 2
register_addresses.0x0044: precise fault code, 64 bits; zero unless stop cause is 3

jtag.access_rule: REGDATA and MEMDATA require the selected target to be halted, exited, or stopped by an unhandled precise fault; exit and fault preserve a readable final architectural snapshot until reset or the next debug write; invalid address, failed target translation, or access while running sets STATUS.ERROR and returns zero without architectural effect
